about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling journey in The Adventures of Candle Boy! An action-packed, third-person, single-player game that blends treasure hunting and enemy evasion in a vibrant, fantastical world.

Step into the shoes of the intrepid Candle Boy, an adventurer determined to steal an enchanted ring of immense power, hidden deep within the heart of a Giant's castle. Along the way, you'll encounter fierce foes, navigate challenging obstacles, and unlock powerful abilities to aid you on your quest.

Traverse beautifully crafted levels and take on engaging side quests to sharpen your skills, enhance your powers, and gain the upper hand in your daring mission to claim the enchanted ring!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
